_comment: One table, read by both implementations of the camera-guide rule: src/lib/cameraGuideGate.test.ts on web and CameraGuideGateTests.swift on iOS. Neither side produces it — it is the spec written down once, so that checking the two ports cannot degenerate into reading the same prose twice and making the same mistake twice.

readSeenCount.name: nothing written anywhere is a new account
the device copy alone, as the string localStorage hands back
offline: the local write landed and the account write did not
the account copy ahead of a stale device copy
a negative is not a count
zero is a count, and is not the same as absence

gate.name: brand new account, first door it walks through
one showing per launch, whatever the count allows
record then upload in one launch is still one showing
an account that already has footage is seeded, not interrupted
the seed is written even when this launch already showed one
filming a first match does not cancel the second showing
already seeded, so there is nothing left to write
a count past the cap still stops
a written zero is not absence, so no back-fill fires
